units: <cite ref="Shabbat 23a:2">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ עושה מצוה</he> the kindling (of the Ḥanukhah lights) is the ceremony prescribed, contrad. to <he>הנחה</he> the placing it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:6">Ib. II, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 31b:10">31ᵇ</cite>) <he>הַדְלָקַת הנר</he> kindling the Sabbath lights.
Y. Ter. V, 43ᶜ top למשחה לה׳ l’moshḥah (Num. XVIII, 8) means (also) for lighting purposes (cmp. מִישְׁחָא).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:2">Num. R. s. 15</cite>, beg. <he>על הַדְלָקָתָן וכ׳</he> concerning feeding them with olive oil.
